judge.rationale: All answers share PTPRC exon-4 splicing and CD45RO as the explanation, and three of four center HNRNPLL, but Answer B instead develops a PTBP1–hnRNP L–SFPQ–GSK3–PI3K/AKT axis and the answers use many differing state markers, leaving more than half of the complete molecular inventories nonshared and invoking the shared-minority ceiling of 4.
